steps.note: Open the existing service RFQ without creating a different event.
Move to the separate supplier session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the service RFQ's pricing round from Vendor A's event list.
Return to the buyer's event page to inspect the submitted response.
Verify the buyer sees Vendor A's submitted response.
Open the buyer's comparison grid containing the activity rates and totals.
Verify the response is shown under the real vendor name.
Verify every activity amount equals its rate times activity quantity and the vendor Sum Total equals the sum of all activity amounts.
